description: This file provides type annotations and function signatures for module loading and saving functions related to Torch's _C extension, specifically for LiteScriptModule and ScriptModule. It defines functions for loading modules from files or bytes and for saving modules to files or bytes.

methods.name: _load_mobile_module_from_file
methods.description: Loads a mobile module from a specified file.

methods.name: _load_mobile_module_from_bytes
methods.description: Loads a mobile module from a byte array.

methods.name: _load_jit_module_from_file
methods.description: Loads a JIT module from a specified file.

methods.name: _load_jit_module_from_bytes
methods.description: Loads a JIT module from a byte array.

methods.name: _save_mobile_module
methods.description: Saves a LiteScriptModule to a specified file.

methods.name: _save_jit_module
methods.description: Saves a ScriptModule to a specified file.
